digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess environment management
propositions: Write and apply paths, Git push, ACLI delivery, and bridge orchestration rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped runtimes, creating credential leak and unintended scope access risks.

Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in the write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that allow writes under unintended scopes or leak Rebar-materialized credentials to unrelated sibling children.

Child-environment builder must selectively project environment variables: trusted same-capability children inherit ambient, owning children receive their adapter overlay, unrelated siblings omit other adapters' exact secret names, and unknown native Git/SSH/AWS/proxy/CA variables survive.

Every implicit DIG Jira-project default (write path resolve_jira_settings, live access-check probe, _CLOUD_PROJECT_DEFAULT constant, _DEFAULT_PROJECT constant) must be eliminated so no request uses DIG unless explicitly configured and unset cases fail closed.
Global os.environ must not be mutated by reconciler or child processes, and concurrent operations with different overlays must not observe cross-operation credential or config values.
